name: chargezen-checkoutos
description: Run your Shopify checkout from Claude: checkout and one-click post-purchase upsells, quantity breaks and automatic discounts, bundles, checkout rules, trust badges, thank-you messages, reviews, gift notes, live chat, branding and gift-card designs, with A/B tests and audits. Requires a Chargezen workspace with CheckoutOS on a Shopify store.
